votes.motion: Approve the work session meeting minutes of November 7, 2023 as well as the formal meeting minutes of November 14, 2023.
votes.description: The Council approved the official minutes from the November 7, 2023 work session and the November 14, 2023 formal meeting.

votes.motion: Close the Public Hearing and refer Item B-1 to a future Consent Agenda for action.
votes.description: The Council closed the public hearing on the Police Department's grant application to Marathon Petroleum for a drone to train first responders, and referred it to a future Consent Agenda for action.

votes.motion: Adopt Ordinance 02 of 2024 Budget Amendment No. 3 for Fiscal Year 2023-24 amending the final budget of Salt Lake City including the Staffing document only for items as shown on the motion sheet.
votes.description: The Council adopted the third budget amendment for FY2023-24, which includes items such as four new full-time paramedics in the Fire Department, creation of a Legislative Division in the City Attorney's Office, and additional transportation impact fees, among other items as specified on the motion sheet.

votes.motion: Adopt Resolution 01 of 2024, requesting that emergency medical service personnel including paramedics and social workers be admitted to the Tier 2 Firefighter Utah Retirement System.
votes.description: The Council adopted a resolution requesting that civilian EMS personnel, including paramedics and social workers in the Fire Department, be admitted to the Tier 2 Firefighter Utah Retirement System, related to the new paramedic positions proposed in Budget Amendment No. 3.

The Council approved the full Consent Agenda, which included setting a public hearing date for a rezone petition, approving Grant Holding Account Items (Batch No. 3) for FY2023-24, and approving four board appointments to the Business Advisory Board, Arts Council Board, and Human Rights Commission.
